words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json exactly as an item's named Effect is added (fight.py expand_library's add_library_effect, with its counters). Matches Thiên Xu's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts): a technique may carry passive arts, each a named Effect with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the passive art's Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
words.decision_reason: checkpoint 2026-11-27 (Neon audit): matches thien_xu-checkpoint.md ('build'). Passive arts exist across ~20 world-depth owners' technique files, and no existing word attaches a technique's named Effects by unlock layer (passives carry plain stat lines only). The Glow Deepens stays in design/stage6-staging/lac_ha/effects/lac_ha.effects.json (now self-contained with glow-clock-pulse / glow-clock-hit, deduplicated by id) with its pending note until technique-effects is wired in the serial build step (fight.py tech_layers + GDScript FighterCompiler / build_file_compiler.gd).

_checkpoint: Checkpoint review 2026-11-27 (Neon audit): technique-effects confirmed 'build' (aligned with thien_xu-checkpoint.md). No new pending words opened.
